result.notes: API v3 is REST, key-based (Bearer token in Authorization header), no free tier — requires Lite plan or higher (paid). Ahrefs Connect offers OAuth 2.0 for third-party developer integrations. Ahrefs also publishes an official hosted MCP server (api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp) available to Lite+ paid plans, using OAuth for client authorization. Older precomputed signal calling it "enterprise_only" appears outdated/imprecise — actual gate is any paid plan (Lite+), not Enterprise-only. Endpoint count/breadth not confirmed from a directly fetched reference page (several docs sub-pages 404'd for the fetch tool), so marked unknown rather than guessed.
result.one_liner: Ahrefs is an SEO and backlink/keyword research platform that exposes a REST API v3 (Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, etc.) and an official MCP server for AI agent access.
